name: Macro dual-calm regime — long crypto only when BOTH equity vol AND credit are calm
rationale: ECONOMIC MECHANISM (a CONFLUENCE filter distinct from the single-gate macro specs macro-vix-calm-riskon-long and macro-credit-spread-stress-derisk): equity-implied vol (VIX) and corporate credit spreads measure DIFFERENT facets of systemic stress — VIX is the equity options market's fear, credit spreads are the bond market's default/liquidity risk. They can diverge: a VIX spike on a transient equity wobble with credit still tight is a false alarm; credit widening while VIX is asleep is a slow-burn stress the equity crowd hasn't priced. Requiring BOTH to be calm is a higher-conviction risk-on regime tag — the macro all-clear that precedes the cleanest crypto up-legs and filters out the single-gauge head-fakes. The cost is fewer trades (the AND is strict), which is the right trade-off for the highest-beta risk asset. Entry: vix_level below a fitted calm ceiling AND credit_spread below a fitted calm ceiling AND price in a non-broken uptrend. Exit: EITHER macro gauge crosses up into stress (VIX up through a panic threshold OR credit up through a widening threshold) or stop/TP/time. Disconfirmer 1: if EITHER single macro gate alone (the existing specs) matches the deflated Sharpe, the confluence adds no value and is just a trade-count reducer. Disconfirmer 2: VIX and credit are correlated; if their joint information is no more than VIX alone, the credit leg is redundant here. Disconfirmer 3: the AND must not so thin the sample that there are too few trades for the gate's min-trades floor — if it fails on count, that is honest evidence the confluence is too rare to trade. Disconfirmer 4 (cost): must beat buy-and-hold deflated Sharpe net of ~20bps. tier0 macro features.
catalyst: equity vol AND credit BOTH calm — a high-conviction macro all-clear for a crypto long
